script_model_with_instances: script a Detectron2 model using torch.jit.script with statically declared Instances fields
export_torchscript_with_instances: export a Detectron2 model in evaluation mode to TorchScript format with custom Instances attributes
dump_torchscript_IR: dump the TorchScript IR, code, and inlined graph of a scripted model to a directory
inspect_scripted_model_code: inspect and dump pretty-printed code of all submodules in a TorchScript model
debug_torchscript_graph: debug a TorchScript model by dumping its graph and inlined graph to text files
